criterion: Can cooling by CO2 and cooling by nitrogen be separated from any dissolved-gas chemistry?
review_instruction: Any CO2 retained in water can participate in carbonate acid-base chemistry; nitrogen does not provide the same acid source. Equal cryogen masses do not imply equal cooling or equal dissolved-gas amounts.

criterion: Account for explicit additions, retained and transferred material, unresolved pools, and any gas/solvent loss before interpreting the result.
review_instruction: Compare all reported inventories and event-level source/sink terms; a successful exit alone is not a chemistry pass.

criterion: Distinguish an unsupported observable or missing coupling from a chemically negative result.
review_instruction: Check warnings, coverage labels and the per-record limitations. Do not fill missing outputs with the expected_result.
